common.footer: You are receiving this email because you have a Yaiwell account. This is an automated message: please do not reply.

bookingConfirmed.subject: Booking confirmed at {provider}
bookingConfirmed.heading: Your booking is confirmed
bookingConfirmed.intro: We have received your payment. {provider} is expecting you.
bookingConfirmed.lastMinute: This is a last-minute booking: it starts less than 2 hours after you made it, so the payment is non-refundable.

bookingCancelled.subject: {provider} has cancelled your booking
bookingCancelled.heading: Your booking has been cancelled
bookingCancelled.intro: {provider} can no longer see you at this time and has cancelled the booking.
bookingCancelled.refundIssued: We are refunding 100% of the amount ({amount}). Depending on your bank, it may take 5 to 10 days to appear.
bookingCancelled.refundPending: We are refunding 100% of the amount ({amount}). The refund is being processed and we will let you know if we need anything from you.
bookingCancelled.refundUncertain: If you were charged, we will refund 100% of the amount ({amount}). We are checking the payment and will let you know if we need anything from you.

latePaymentRefunded.subject: We couldn't confirm your booking at {provider}
latePaymentRefunded.heading: Your booking was not confirmed
latePaymentRefunded.intro: Your payment arrived after that time was no longer available at {provider}, so we couldn't confirm the booking.

refundCompleted.subject: We have refunded your payment for {provider}
refundCompleted.heading: Refund sent
refundCompleted.intro: We have refunded 100% of the amount ({amount}) for your booking at {provider}. Depending on your bank, it may take 5 to 10 days to appear.

refundDelayed.subject: Your refund from {provider} has been delayed
refundDelayed.heading: Your refund has been delayed
refundDelayed.intro: Your bank could not receive the {amount} refund for your booking at {provider}.
refundDelayed.next: We are processing it again and will write to you as soon as it goes through. You do not need to do anything.

reviewInvite.subject: How was {provider}?
reviewInvite.heading: How was your appointment?
reviewInvite.intro: {provider} has marked your {service} appointment as completed. Your review helps others choose.
reviewInvite.window: You can leave a review for the next {days} days.

bookingReminder.subject: Your appointment at {provider} is tomorrow
bookingReminder.heading: See you tomorrow
bookingReminder.intro: A quick reminder of your appointment tomorrow at {provider}.

providerApproved.subject: {provider} is now live on Yaiwell
providerApproved.heading: You're on Yaiwell
providerApproved.intro: We have reviewed {provider} and it now appears in search results. Your services can be booked from now on.

providerRejected.subject: We need to review some details of {provider}
providerRejected.heading: Your application needs changes
providerRejected.intro: We have reviewed {provider} and cannot publish it yet. This is the reason:
providerRejected.next: Update your details from your dashboard and we will review it again.
